label: Gamma+Linear+netpump6+fp+sw-arade-1

variants.esp: ESP: observed years resampled as weather members (P and ET0 jointly, the target year left out), each with its own irrigation demand; 10 parameter samples; OU noise from the anchor residual with the leave-one-year-out inflation k; the scored band
variants.known: known forcing: the weather that actually came, one member; the ceiling a perfect weather forecast would reach

postprocess.rule: the step-16 (d) conditional correction the product applies: every quantile shifted by z_bias x the band's sd of the day and the deviations from the mean scaled by `spread`, fitted leave-one-origin-year-out and read from the season-end rows, so one shift and one factor move the whole band, as scripts/08_forecast.py does

config.not_applied: the east (the correction gains nothing there: 1 Apr season-end CRPSS 0.540 -> 0.531 leave-one-year-out), 596/259 (sector `uncertain`: one well, so a per-sector fit does no pooling - below MIN_NODE_SITES = 2; its leave-one-year-out fit gained +0.099 at 1 April and is an open item, not a product form), a 1 October issue (0.325 -> 0.260, it loses), any date before 1 April or at and after the season-end target

inflation.rule: bands drawn with the leave-one-year-out k of the origin year (per-origin noise_k); the anchor carries the full-sample k

grid.note: every 2nd day of the 199-day window (file over 400 kB at daily resolution)

note: The hindcast refit the model parameters on the dips before each origin and anchored on the last dip before it; the simulation line the page draws comes from the current anchor (the full-record fit in site/data/<slug>.json), so the two need not meet at the origin. Bands: 50 and 90 % central intervals over weather members, parameter samples and the residual noise seeded at the anchor, noise sd x k (leave-one-year-out).
